changes.observable_property: All Prayer for Repose explanatory text uses one player-facing model: the base effect talks about higher body-quality tiers; Bronze opens the next tier while one remains; Silver increases the chance of receiving the best body among those already available; Gold guarantees the best available body; at the Bronze terminal state the text says no new tiers can be unlocked and summarizes the three prayer qualities with their native star glyphs.
changes.canonical_owner: The shared Repose base wording is owned by active.skull in lang/*.json and is consumed by the existing forecast/Rebalanced presentation paths. Rebalanced tier wording is owned by rebalanced.active.repose.bronze/silver/gold in lang_rebalanced/*.json. The Rebalanced Bronze endpoint wording is owned by rebalanced.repose.endpoint_bronze and rebalanced.repose.endpoint_bronze_hint, selected by PulpitLayoutV5.OverrideSpecialPresentation.
changes.final_writer_or_commit_point: Existing presentation writers remain unchanged: PrayerForecast/RebalancedPresentationSemantics consume active.skull and the Rebalanced tier keys, while PulpitLayoutV5.OverrideSpecialPresentation writes the Bronze endpoint SpecialText. This change alters only their localized strings and candidate identity.
